verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a company-formation and back-office service covering registered agent, accounting, tax, mailroom and banking access. It is not an e-signature or developer platform, so embedding a signing experience in a developer's own app is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships e-signature or embeddable signing, and the probes found no API spec.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed the signing experience inside my own app or website
